notes: Money loop: record payments and apply them oldest-invoice-first with the remainder left as credit; new Money tab showing who owes what; read invoice status, number and balance back from Wix; get a customer-viewable invoice link; send an invoice by email (confirmation required). Order emails can be tagged with their Gmail thread so the same order cannot be invoiced twice. Sales reports by product/category/customer/market, customer history and repeat-last-order, and price/alias edits from Claude. Fixes: pushing the same invoice twice no longer creates a second Wix draft.
